components.name: Quest Action
components.description: The single ember action mounted like a campaign-table control.
components.css: .ds-quest-action{background:var(--quest);color:var(--quest-foreground);border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch,currentColor 18%,transparent);border-radius:4px;padding:16px 28px;font:700 15px Geist,system-ui;box-shadow:0 5px 0 var(--quest-shadow);transition:transform 180ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease}.ds-quest-action:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-quest-action:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ring);outline-offset:3px}.ds-quest-action:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--quest-shadow)}

components.name: Atlas Label
components.description: A pinned vellum label for one selectable role location.
components.css: .ds-atlas-label{background:var(--parchment);color:var(--parchment-foreground);border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch,currentColor 24%,transparent);border-radius:4px;padding:8px 10px;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 5px 10px rgba(20,9,4,.28)}.ds-atlas-label strong,.ds-atlas-label span{display:block}.ds-atlas-label:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ring);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Command Well
components.description: A recessed dark field for exact commands.
components.html: npx rallypoint@latest add loop
components.css: .ds-command{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:var(--surface-deep);color:var(--parchment);border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--parchment) 30%,transparent);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px 8px 18px;box-shadow:inset 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.38)}.ds-command code{font:13px 'Geist Mono',monospace}.ds-command button{color:inherit;background:transparent;border:0;min-width:40px;min-height:40px}.ds-command button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ring)}

narrative.overview: Rallypoint turns a repository into an original traversable expedition world. Authored cartography and creature plates make each role, boundary, and handoff memorable while semantic operational truth stays crisp.
keyCharacteristics: Authored cartography instead of abstract geometry

rules.name: The Ember Route Rule
rules.body: Ember marks progress or action, never generic decoration.

dos: Do make every location visibly inhabited and functionally distinct.
Do keep commands truthful and copyable.
donts: Don't use generic geometric game pieces.
Don't copy any roleplaying publisher's trade dress.
Don't use glass, neon gradients, or repeated rounded cards.
